scope: Record the GTK2 generated down-stepper PRELIGHT edge inconsistency before correcting the palette-derived composition.

evidence.cause: The generator copies the KDE-role-derived trough face into row 0, x=2..12, of down-normal and down-pressed, but not down-focused. GTK2 PRELIGHT therefore differs from the source-equivalent normal state by 11 pixels only for the lower arrow.

interpretation: This is a generated-state inconsistency introduced by the orientation edge repair, not a demonstrated mismatch to historical SR10.4 hover. The source artwork has identical normal and focused pixels; preserving that relation after applying the role-derived edge correction avoids a hover-only discontinuity.
planned_change: Apply the same palette-derived trough face to down-focused row 0, x=2..12. Keep pressed relief and all other cells unchanged. Validate exact normal/PRELIGHT equality after generation across two palettes and retain the native hover comparison as unverified.
